facts.value: Prince Eugene of Savoy's library of 15,000 volumes stands in the middle oval, bound in red, blue and yellow Morocco leather.
facts.quote: the library of Prince Eugene in the middle oval, containing 15,000 volumes bound in red, blue and yellow Morocco leather
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.onb.ac.at/en/museums/state-hall/about-the-state-hall' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F '15,000 volumes bound in red, blue and yellow Morocco leather'

facts.value: The marble statue of Emperor Charles VI at the centre shows him as Hercules Musarum. It dates from 1735 and was allegedly made by court sculptor Antonio Corradini.
facts.quote: It dates back to 1735 and was allegedly crafted by Imperial Court sculptor Antonio Corradini
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.onb.ac.at/en/museums/state-hall/about-the-state-hall/the-state-halls-statues' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'It dates back to 1735 and was allegedly crafted by Imperial Court sculptor Antonio Corradini'

facts.value: During the restoration that ran to the end of 2022 the books were covered, then taken from the shelves one by one and cleaned once the work was finished.
facts.quote: were professionally covered during the restoration and were removed from the shelves one by one and cleaned after the work was completed
